text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALES - The Taiwan Flour Mills Association on Thursday bought two shipments totalling 80,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat. Each 40,000-tonne cargo contains Dark Northern Spring, Hard Red Winter and White Wheat and both were slated for Nov 20-Dec 10 delivery from Pacific Northwest.

- A Philippine flour mill bought 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat early this week. Traders said that of the 40,000 tonnes, some 23,000 tonnes of DNS wheat were bought for $192-$193 a tonne and 17,000 tonnes of western white wheat at $153-$155.
PALM OIL SALE - Pakistan bought 4,500 tonnes RBD palm oil at $529.40 per tonne C & F for shipment by December 10.
VEGOIL SALE - Morocco bought 48,000 tonnes of optional origin vegetable oil at $544.5 per tonne C&F for delivery between February and April.

WHEAT TENDERS - Algeria has passed up offers in a tender it launched to import 150,000 tonnes of U.S and/or Canadian durum wheat. The wheat was for shipment in December, January and February. There was no official confirmation that Algeria had passed on the tender. Traders did not know if Algeria planned to re-tender for wheat soon.

WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC said it tendered Nov 13 for up to 80,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat, ordinary protein, soft red winter and/or soft white wheat for Bangladesh. Shipment would be Dec 1-25, 1996.
- The CCC was to tender on November 20 for up to 16,910 tonnes of U.S. number two hard red winter wheat for export to Mozambique. Shipment was slated for December 5-31.

- The CCC said it was tendering on November 21 for up to 16,100 tonnes of U.S. wheat for export to Iraq. Shipment was slated for December 5-30. It sought number two or better wheat, excluding unclassed, mixed and durum wheat.
WHEAT TENDER - Pakistan is likely to tender for at least 200,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat in about a week's time, a Ministry of Food and Agriculture official said.

CORN TENDER - South Africa Maize Board was offering 30,000 tonnes yellow maize for export or domestic use. The offer closes November 21. If for export use, the maize would be shipped during December as a single 30,000 tonne unit.
RICE TENDER - Two Pakistani firms have won tenders to supply a total of 41,800 tonnes of rice to the Grain Board of Iraq after getting clearance from the UN sanctions committee.
MARKET TALK - U.S. rice exporters said a sale of 46,000 tonnes U.S. long grain paddy rice to Costa Rica was close to completion but not officially awarded.

... Egypt is due to tender on November 15 to buy 50,000 tonnes of French wheat and 100,000 tonnes of Argentine wheat for shipment in December. It is also seeking to import 50,000 tonnes of Australian wheat for shipment in December, exporters said. But some exporters speculate that Egypt may buy more wheat than it is tendering for as it did in previous tenders.

... Members of the European Union's grain committee on Thursday discussed plans to open a tender next week for the export of 100,000 tonnes of EU free-market durum wheat to countries outside the EU, EU grain officials said.

... Russian grain imports may reach six to eight million tonnes in 1996/97 (July/June), including four to five million tonnes of food grains, private agricultural consulatant Andrei Sizov said on Thursday. Imports totalled just over five million tonnes in 1995/96.
... Turkey is planning to reduce a 15-percent tax on wheat imports in a bid to cut import costs, a grain official said.
